Name: Instant Growth Powder - Continued
Author: recon88
Description:
[size=5]Overview[/size]
[size=2]This mod allows you to craft Instant Growth Powder, a magic substance that is imbued with prismatic, void, and solar essences, causing anything it is sprinkled on to instantly mature.

[/size][size=5]Use[/size][size=2]
Simply craft the Instant Growth Powder and click on anything that is able to grow:
- Crops
- Tea Bushes (also supports modded bushed based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20619]Custom Bush[/url])
- Trees (including Fruit Trees)
- Animals
- Children

Some objects require a leftclick instead of a rightlick, for example animals.

The powder also works when being placed in Enrichers and will be applied to all regrowable crops in range.

Bonus: It is also compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url]. Hold the powder in your hands while driving through your fields and watch your crops grow instantly.﻿

[size=5]Recipe
[/size]The recipe can be changed in the file [b][i][color=#d9ead3]Mods\InstantGrowthPowderContinued\assets\json-assets\Objects\Instant Growth Powder\object.json[/color][/i][/b]
You can add/remove/change the ingredients to your liking. Everything else shouldn't be changed or the mod might break.
By default it is using [i][b]1 Prismatic Shard (ID 74), 10 Solar Essences (ID 768) and 10 Void Essences (ID 769)[/b][/i]
[code]    "Ingredients": [
      {
        "Object": 74,
        "Count": 1
      },
      {
        "Object": 768,
        "Count": 10
      },
      {
        "Object": 769,
        "Count": 10
      }
    ],
[/code]
[/size]
[size=5]Config[/size]
[code]{
  "EnableMod": true
}
[/code]

[size=5]Requirements
[/size]This mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url].
